prompt: automake dist distcheck -n creating directories bug fix version
answer:
The recursive `make distcheck` directory-cleanup bug was fixed in Automake commit `866eab242` on September 2, 2026. It is included in the `automake 1.18.94` tag and listed as a new feature for Automake 1.19.

The fix prevents `make dist` from propagating its internal distribution-directory cleanup override to recursive makes, which could leave a nested `distcheck` distribution directory behind and cause the `distclean` check to fail.
